fixes.old: Third Almohad caliph; builder of the Koutoubia and the Giralda.
fixes.new: Third Almohad caliph; he completed the Giralda in Seville and commissioned the Hassan Tower in Rabat.
fixes.reason: the Koutoubia was begun by Abd al-Mu'min and the Giralda's mosque by his father in 1171; his own commission was the Hassan Tower (1191-1199)
